verdict: All Hebrew lines on 278 were checked against the four wide bands, the full native page and the new full-height crops. No line was cut off at the bottom, so there is no whole-page meteg blockage. Consonants, full and defective spellings, maqaf, dagesh and meteg match the candidate except for one real discrepancy: the period after אַם שַׁבָּת (patch above). Three point-level readings remain open (לְמָאָס mem, וְתוֹלְדוֹת lamed, the ayin-patah in the first מַעַשׂ), so pointing is not approved. Human416/417 and the בראשי החרוזות consensus are confirmed against the image. The English on 279 rests on the earlier full check.
